

❯ /output-style
  ⎿  Output style: Concise

     Available styles:
     - default
     - Proactive: Claude executes immediately, minimizes
       interruptions, and prefers action over planning
     - Concise (current): Claude responds tersely, leading with
       results and skipping preamble and narration
     - Explanatory: Claude explains its implementation choices
       and codebase patterns
     - Learning: Claude pauses and asks you to write small
       pieces of code for hands-on practice

     Usage: /output-style <style>

❯ /copy
  ⎿  No assistant message to copy

❯ /fast
  ⎿  Fast mode OFF

❯ /effort
  ⎿  Cancelled

   Effort

           Faster                             Smarter
           ────────────────────▲─────────────────────
           low     medium     high     xhigh      max

                         Tab to toggle

   ←/→ to adjust · Enter to confirm · s for this session only
